definitions.source_population: All original 19456 requests from the same seed; preserve every SSD block placement
definitions.binding: Only declared input NPU binding and queue-position IDs may change; runtime must keep the new manifest binding
definitions.warm_validity: Every declared pure-role NPU active throughout [2000,4000), positive compute in its assigned role; four completions by1500; no per-card mixing requirement
definitions.main_slo: Requests admitted in [2000,4000), followed through completion; completion-admission <=1.5*8*per_layer_C
definitions.static_role_bound: Per SSD, n_long*max_over_source_long(V_s/C)+n_short*max_over_source_short(V_s/C); any pure-role binding/order, fixed physical placements
definitions.capacity_scope: Current admitted-profile nominal V/C, not SSD throughput, released-I/O burst capacity, or a deadline guarantee
definitions.warm_cohort_caveat: Warm admission populations depend on policy/order; complete populations remain matched
